method: Reopened the public The Mountain Our Story and NICENESS G.BERNARD product page, and checked only claim-bearing passages. Used The Mountain chronology as the company’s own retrospective, not independent verification. The Mountain page prose dates the store sale to 1996 while an adjacent timeline heading says 1991; the article flags this discrepancy and avoids treating either date as settled. NICENESS’s reference description is separated from the current G.BERNARD product and its made-in-Nicaragua statement. No images or third-party text were reproduced. SHA-256 identifies the local research snapshot only and does not establish source authenticity or independent review.

The Mountainの自社史は、Three Wolf Moon後にBig Face動物Tシャツを始めたと記す。
